'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war]], [[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
*****Three children are killed and several others are injured after an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] hits a tent encampment in the [[Nuseirat refugee camp]], resulting in a fire which spread through parts of the camp. Altogether, at least 45 people are killed from today's attacks. [https://aje.io/v8wiq7?update=3664963 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli settler violence]]
***[[Israeli settlers]] in the [[West Bank]] shoot and injure five [[Palestinians]] and set fire to several homes and farmland. [https://aje.io/v8wiq7?update=3664921 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***[[April 2025 Russian attack on Kyiv]]
****Twelve people [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|are killed]] and around 90 others, including children, are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Hwasong-11A|KN-23]] [[ballistic missile]] strike on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/russia-ukraine-war/article/russian-strike-on-kyiv-kills-12-in-biggest-attack-on-ukrainian-capital-since-last-summer/ (CTV News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missile-that-killed-eight-russian-strike-kyiv-was-nkorean-kyiv-source-says-2025-04-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants seize the town of Wargaadhi and its [[military base]] in [[Middle Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. More than 40 militants and twelve [[Somali clans|clan]] fighters are killed in related combat. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/4/24/al-shabab-battles-somalias-army-for-strategic-military-base (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**The [[Politics of Benin|Beninese government]] announces that 54 [[Benin Armed Forces|soldiers]] were killed in an attack by [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin]] (JNIM) in the north of [[Benin|the country]] last week, after previously announcing only eight soldiers were killed. JNIM claims 70 soldiers were killed in the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4grjgkxn9vo (BBC News)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
** At least 20 people are killed in an attack by gunmen on the village of Gobirawa Chali in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-attack-zamfara-amnesty-international-a9325d55ec4009b6b3e63cc0c04134fc (AP News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2025 in archaeology]]
**Archaeologists from the [[University of Barcelona]] confirm that the remains discovered in [[Valls]], Catalonia, [[Spain]], correspond to the ancient Iberian city of Cissa, the scene of the [[Battle of Cissa]] during the [[Second Punic War]]. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20250424/hallan-valls-restos-ciudad-ibera-kissa-escenario-guerras-punicas/16552772.shtml (RTVE)]

[https://www.wfmynews2.com/article/news/traffic/crash-eden-nc-multiple-roads-closed-police-investigating/83-a6e1843e-1cb7-4bbb-8393-61d3a73ce290 (WFMY-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[India–Pakistan relations]]
**[[2025 India–Pakistan diplomatic crisis]]
***[[Pakistan]] closes its [[India–Pakistan border|land border]] and shared [[airspace]] with India indefinitely following the [[2025 Pahalgam attack|attack on tourists]] in [[Pahalgam]], [[India]]-administered [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Kashmir]], several days prior, and [[Government of India|India]]'s executive actions against Pakistan yesterday. [https://www.dw.com/en/pahalgam-attack-pakistan-closes-land-air-borders-to-india/live-72328930 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship in Mexico]]
**A joint commission of the [[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Senate (Mexico)|Senate]] approves a proposal submitted by [[President of Mexico|President]] [[Claudia Sheinbaum]] that would grant the government the power to block and censor digital platforms, including social networks, websites, and apps, indefinitely and without a court order. The proposal will be sent to the government-aligned majority in [[Congress (Mexico)|Congress]] for further approval. [https://www.milenio.com/politica/comisiones-del-senado-avalan-ley-de-telecomunicaciones (''Milenio'')]
*[[Highland Park parade shooting]]
**24-year-old Robert E. Crimo is sentenced to 21 [[life imprisonment|life sentences]] for killing seven people and injuring 48 others in a [[mass shooting]] during the 2022 [[Independence Day (United States)|Independence Day]] parade in [[Highland Park, Illinois|Highland Park]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/04/24/us/robert-crimo-iii-july-fourth-parade-shooter-to-be-sentenced/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Jones Road Fire]]
**A 19-year-old is arrested and charged with [[arson]] on suspicion of starting an ongoing large [[wildfire]] that has burned 15,000 acres in [[Ocean County, New Jersey|Ocean County]], [[New Jersey]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/13000-acres-burned-new-jersey-smoke-expected-hit/story?id=121115949 (ABC News)]
*[[2025 Nantes school stabbing]]
**One student is killed and three others are critically injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a [[private school]] in [[Nantes]], [[Pays de la Loire]], [[France]]. A 15-year-old student is detained. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-nantes-school-stabbing-one-35095063 (''Daily Mirror'')]
*The perpetrator is killed and at least four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a used car dealership in the [[Glenvar Heights, Florida|Glenvar Heights]], [[Florida]], United States. [https://wsvn.com/news/local/miami-dade/suspect-in-sw-miami-dade-warehouse-shooting-that-left-several-injured-is-dead-7news-sources-say/ (WSVN)] [https://www.local10.com/news/local/2025/04/24/developing-deputies-respond-to-shooting-in-miami-dade-warehouse-area/ (WPLG)]
*Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] is indicted on charges of alleged [[corruption]] and [[bribery]] for receiving [[South Korean won|₩]]217 million (US$152,000) in connection with his son-in-law's employment at airline [[Eastar Jet]] in [[Thailand]].
